additional_info.subject: RE: ID00448816-DC/Si-D/GB-[Y2/T5314234864006] Serial number cant be found on SCB CRM:02888000221
additional_info.body:
Good afternoon Jason,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID00448816.
As I understood from your description, you cannot find the serial number related to charger Y2/T5314234864006 on SCB.
I checked customer order
314234864
on SCB, which is related to the other chargers you mentioned, and I confirm that I do not see the serial number listed above.
In order to sort this situation out, I would suggest:
Double-check the serial number of the charger on the metal plaque on the bottom left side of the charger.
Power on the charger and verify the ChargerID.
Once you provide me with feedback, I will guide through the next and, if needed, report the problem to the respective representatives.
Looking forward to hearing form you soon!
With kind regards,
